component.name: Ant Food Diary
component.summary: A text-first app for recording and viewing calories, weight, and other daily events

description.p: The tagline of this app is: eat like an ant, lift like a lion. We hope to help you with your weight loss and muscle-building goals.

AntFoodDiary is a text-first food, workout, and weight recorder and tracker. The database file is just a semi-structured text file that can be edited with any text editor. The GUI takes that text file and organizes/summarizes it in a convenient calendar view.

ul.li: Edit the notes for each day, including food consumed, weight recorded, bowel movements, and any other notes you feel are worth keeping track of
Search for the days that you performed a particular activity
View interactive graphs of the details of your diet over time

description.p: The app is built using the Kirigami framework and the latest KDE libs.
First version, includes settings for diary file and default templates on new days.

ul.li: Edit days in the calendar view
Search daily information for interesting occurences
View graphs of your calorie consumption and weight over time
